caption: A heavy cast-iron pan is dropped onto a stovetop, and the lids of neighbouring pots rattle for a moment.

sa.check: A stovetop with pots that have lids on.
A heavy cast-iron pan is dropped onto the stovetop.
The lids of the neighbouring pots rattle.
The pan is dropped rather than set down: it falls the last stretch.
The pan lands first and the lids rattle after.

pc.expect: The lids are still until the pan lands and begin rattling at the impact.
pc.fail: Lids rattle while the pan is still in the air; or the pan lands and the lids stay dead still; or lids start rattling again after settling with no second impact.

pc.expect: The rattle dies away and the lids come to rest seated on their pots.
pc.fail: The rattle grows after the impact; or keeps going unchanged to the end of the clip; or a lid freezes in mid-hop above its pot.

pc.expect: The pan falls down onto the stove and stays; lids that hop fall back.
pc.fail: The pan hangs in the air before landing; or a lid lifts off and stays up; or the pan lands and then rises again.

pc.expect: The pan, the stovetop and the lids stay rigid.
pc.fail: The pan bends or splashes like a liquid; or the stovetop ripples; or a lid bends.

pc.expect: The pots and lids keep their count; one pan; nothing passes through the stovetop.
pc.fail: A pot or lid appears or vanishes; or the pan passes through the stovetop; or the pan and a pot merge; or the pan vanishes.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The pots' colours, the stove knobs and the pan's size stay the same.
pc.fail: Pots change colour; or the stove knobs change; or the pan changes size.

note: The hand that drops the pan is a trigger and is not judged.
